member.name: P:bolt.module.powerfx.verbs.PowerFxReplVerb.OptionalAuthProfile
member.summary:
The active auth profile for the execution of this verb. May be null if the user doesn't have any auth profiles.
This property is generated by declaring the AuthenticatedAttribute and setting its AuthenticatedAttribute.Optional to `true`.
